_doc: P6-d (machine-day F14) native step-1 SPIKE at 65a8b419 = development 6c78780c + the THROWAWAY wait phase (branch feat/p6d14, local, not for merge): phase `preview` in _rfl_sequence after the positioning and before the spindle start, exit on the start check itself (_start_verdict, the one call _begin_run_basis uses too), bound 90 s from one deadline, a wake on each publication, no lock held; run_basis carries verified_against (a projection of its own fields, only when verified); `run_basis.written` traces the AUTO write itself (run_basis.start is the start's RECORD, emitted before further awaits and the write thread). NO test variable. The page code is 6c78780c's (unchanged). The VM's real LinuxCNC, the 3-axis sim profile in a confined copy of the run tree, through the native stage's machinery; a local driver ~/claude-work/p6d/f14/ (spike_native.py, spike_drive.sh, spike_analyze.py, spike_record.py; step 0's p6d_probe.mjs = a real headless Chromium page with the device's simulation ON on the Sim tab, never armed). Program A = step 0's (T1 M600 on line 3, 20,000 padding lines, start line N 20008, ~25 s of motion), B = A without the M600, C = a 3-line program. Every RFL is ONE auto_run as the dialog sends it (line N, version/source/program id, spindle forward 1000, safe_z, entry X100 Y100 G54 G21, pre_tool=1 with the section's values). Times in seconds from each case's start mark; page telemetry by the browser's own clock; *_rel_write_s relative to run_basis.written. RUN 1: a1 (FAST values #3006 3000 #3005 200), a2 (step 0's values), confirm (MDI G54 - a NO-OP: the basis had been confirmed by the read-back at the load already; bookings identical before and after), b (confirmed basis: #3014 read at the load, the other keys applied by a2 with the same values, b applying them again), c (in the wait: load_file of B, then A's text changed on disk), d (Abort in the wait), e (program B, no pre-measurement). FINDING of run 1: load_file has no AUTO pre-step (BG-03); a load from MDI/MANUAL leaves the task there and the read-back CONFIRMED the basis 1.7 s after the publication, before a1 - so run 1's a1/a2 ran on a CONFIRMED basis whose values the apply changed. RUN 2 (assumed): prep = program C run in AUTO, A loaded FROM AUTO (no read-back is due there), so the basis stayed ASSUMED (#3014 from the file, never read back) through a1 (fast), a1b (fast) and a2 (step 0's values).
